authPage.heroBody: TaskFlow brings clarity to your day. Sign in or create a free account to start managing your to-dos with real-time sync, smart filtering, and a workspace that's entirely yours.
authPage.formBody: Sign in to your account or create one in seconds. No credit card, no setup — just your email and a password.
authPage.ctaBody: Join thousands of people who use TaskFlow to turn scattered thoughts into finished work. Create your free account now — no payment details required, ever.
authPage.toggleToSignup: Don't have an account? Create one
authPage.toggleToSignin: Already have an account? Sign in

dashboardPage.headerBody: Here's everything on your plate today. Stay focused, knock things out, and let TaskFlow keep track of the rest.
dashboardPage.tasksBody: Each task updates in real time — check one off on your phone and it disappears from your laptop instantly.
dashboardPage.addBody: Type your task and press Enter or click Add — it'll appear in your list instantly.
dashboardPage.emptyHeading: Nothing here yet — enjoy the calm.
dashboardPage.emptyBody: When you're ready, add your first task above and TaskFlow will keep it safe, synced, and sorted for you.
